'''AB-US3''' was a training droid used by various individuals during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

He could take significant damage from an opponent: from a blaster bolt to an attack with a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. The droid's damage log kept track of exactly what types of attack were used on him and how much damage had been dealt to it.
